<document id="cushion-repayment">
RepayingˆCushionˆWhenˆCushionˆcoversˆaˆpurchase,ˆyourˆbalanceˆgoesˆbelowˆzero.ˆHere'sˆhowˆitˆgetsˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆ##ˆAutomaticˆrepaymentˆAnyˆmoneyˆthatˆcomesˆin,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆaˆtransferˆorˆaˆrefund,ˆgoesˆtowardˆtheˆnegativeˆbalanceˆfirst.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆdoˆanything.ˆ##ˆPayingˆitˆbackˆyourselfˆYouˆcanˆaddˆmoneyˆatˆanyˆtimeˆbyˆtransfer,ˆBrookPayˆfromˆanotherˆmember,ˆorˆaˆcashˆdepositˆatˆaˆstore.ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆstaysˆnegativeˆ-ˆAfterˆ30ˆdays,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspendedˆuntilˆyou'reˆbackˆatˆzeroˆandˆmeetˆtheˆdirectˆdepositˆrequirementˆagain.ˆ-ˆAfterˆ60ˆdays,ˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestricted.ˆYouˆcanˆstillˆaddˆmoney,ˆbutˆyouˆcan'tˆspendˆorˆsendˆitˆuntilˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆrepaid.ˆ##ˆCostˆThereˆareˆnoˆfeesˆorˆinterestˆforˆusingˆCushion,ˆandˆnoneˆforˆrepayingˆlate.ˆTheˆonlyˆconsequencesˆareˆsuspensionˆandˆrestriction.ˆ##ˆCanˆIˆcloseˆmyˆaccountˆwhileˆit'sˆnegative?ˆNo.ˆBringˆtheˆbalanceˆtoˆzeroˆfirst.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="cushion-premium">
CushionˆonˆPremiumˆOnˆPremium,ˆCushionˆcoversˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆupˆtoˆ$200ˆbelowˆzero,ˆwithˆnoˆfee.ˆ##ˆTurningˆitˆonˆGoˆtoˆProfile,ˆthenˆCushion.ˆYouˆneedˆatˆleastˆ$500ˆinˆdirectˆdepositsˆinˆtheˆlastˆ30ˆdays.ˆIfˆyouˆstopˆmeetingˆthat,ˆCushionˆpausesˆuntilˆyouˆdoˆagain.ˆ##ˆExampleˆIfˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆlowˆandˆyouˆbuyˆgroceriesˆthatˆcostˆmoreˆthanˆyouˆhave,ˆCushionˆcoversˆtheˆdifferenceˆasˆlongˆasˆtheˆtotalˆbelowˆzeroˆstaysˆwithinˆ$200.ˆAˆpurchaseˆthatˆwouldˆtakeˆyouˆpastˆ$200ˆbelowˆzeroˆisˆdeclined.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆCushionˆcoversˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆonly.ˆItˆneverˆcoversˆATMˆwithdrawals,ˆtransfersˆorˆwires.ˆ##ˆRepayingˆYourˆnextˆdepositˆrepaysˆit.ˆIfˆyouˆstayˆnegativeˆforˆ30ˆdays,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspended.ˆIfˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆstillˆnegativeˆafterˆ60ˆdays,ˆtheˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆuntilˆit'sˆrepaid.ˆ##ˆCostˆCushionˆhasˆnoˆfeesˆandˆnoˆinterestˆ($0.00).ˆItˆisn'tˆaˆloanˆandˆisn'tˆreportedˆtoˆcreditˆbureaus.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="cushion-plus">
CushionˆonˆPlusˆOnˆPlus,ˆCushionˆcoversˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆbelowˆzero,ˆwithˆnoˆfee.ˆ##ˆTurningˆitˆonˆGoˆtoˆProfile,ˆthenˆCushion.ˆYouˆneedˆatˆleastˆ$500ˆinˆdirectˆdepositsˆinˆtheˆlastˆ30ˆdays.ˆIfˆyouˆstopˆmeetingˆthat,ˆCushionˆpausesˆuntilˆyouˆdoˆagain.ˆ##ˆExampleˆIfˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆlowˆandˆyouˆbuyˆgroceriesˆthatˆcostˆmoreˆthanˆyouˆhave,ˆCushionˆcoversˆtheˆdifferenceˆasˆlongˆasˆtheˆtotalˆbelowˆzeroˆstaysˆwithinˆ$50.00.ˆAˆpurchaseˆthatˆwouldˆtakeˆyouˆpastˆ$50.00ˆbelowˆzeroˆisˆdeclined.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆCushionˆcoversˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆonly.ˆItˆneverˆcoversˆATMˆwithdrawals,ˆtransfersˆorˆwires.ˆ##ˆRepayingˆYourˆnextˆdepositˆrepaysˆit.ˆIfˆyouˆstayˆnegativeˆforˆ30ˆdays,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspended.ˆIfˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆstillˆnegativeˆafterˆ60ˆdays,ˆtheˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆuntilˆit'sˆrepaid.ˆ##ˆCostˆCushionˆhasˆnoˆfeesˆandˆnoˆinterestˆ($0.00).ˆItˆisn'tˆaˆloanˆandˆisn'tˆreportedˆtoˆcreditˆbureaus.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
